micronutrientNote: Micronutrients are present only where USDA measured them. An absent key means unmeasured, not zero — reporting an unmeasured nutrient as 0 would tell a user their meal contains no iron when in fact nobody looked. Live FoodData Central lookups capture these automatically, so coverage grows as the cache fills.
